svg.aria-label: One gateway, each app on its own resources. Requests for five apps enter one gateway. A static page is served from the bundle store without waking anything. A browser request to survey passes the login, gets a subject header, wakes the survey container, touches its own volume and database, and survey later sleeps when idle. A WebSocket to ttt wakes it and keeps it awake while the socket is open, using its own Redis key prefix. A cron trigger wakes widget. A presigned upload goes straight from the browser to the album bucket in RustFS without passing the gateway, and album stays asleep. Shared services underneath, Docker, volumes, SQLite or Postgres, Redis and RustFS, are partitioned per app by name; this is namespacing on one trusted host, not tenant isolation.
svg.title: One gateway, each app on its own resources
svg.text: One gateway, every app on its own resources
Every request enters through the same gateway. Each app keeps its own volume, database, key prefix and bucket.
Names are namespaced per app on one trusted host, so apps never trample each other.
This is not tenant isolation: containers share one network and the operator trusts every image.
